name: Moodify trilingual mood benchmark
description: Labelled mood inputs in English (en), Hindi in Devanagari (hi) and Romanised Hinglish (hinglish). 6 items per mood per language. Each item has one gold mood; a prediction is correct when targetMoods[0] equals it. Do not edit labels after the first run, and never reuse these sentences as prompt examples.
